newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks lower in meagre OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks lower in meagre OTC trade.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter market in Varazdin including its Osijek outpost, for Tuesday, October 22.
* Of eleven active stocks four fell, two rose and five were unchanged.
* Volume lower at 1,851 units, turnover also down at 98,419 German marks.
* 10-stock VIN index 1.5 percent down to 9,263 points.
* Biggest loser was electronic firm Ericsson Tesla which fell 16.7 percent to 50 marks, selling 99 shares.
* Top gainer was Istrian hotelier Istraturist, 3.9 percent up to 80 marks, but only ten shares were sold.
* The most actively traded issue was textile firm Varteks 3.6 percent up to 29 marks on volume of 544 shares.
